name: Lorgus Jett
summary: In Blackfathom Deeps, Lorgus Jett commands the Twilight's Hammer among flooded ruins. The Horde has marked him as a target.

sections.title: A Defiler in the Ruins
sections.body: Lorgus Jett is a human among the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. While many cultists there are orcs or tauren, Jett ranges from the upper Moonshrine Ruins to the tunnels beyond Gelihast, the murloc defiler. He coordinates the cult's rituals and violent ambitions in the ancient night elf ruins.

faq.answer: Lorgus Jett serves the Twilight's Hammer inside Blackfathom Deeps. He oversees the cult's work in the Moonshrine Ruins and serves the Old Gods.

faq.q: Where can Lorgus Jett be found in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Lorgus Jett patrols the Moonshrine Ruins. He may be near the first groups of Twilight cultists or farther along the flooded passages past Gelihast's shrine.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Lorgus Jett dead?
aliases: allegiance to the old gods quest
faq.answer: The Horde seeks Lorgus Jett's death through Allegiance to the Old Gods. His presence in Ashenvale threatens regional stability, and he serves an alliance devoted to unleashing ancient, world-ending entities.

faq.q: Why does a human use shamanistic powers?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer communes with chaotic elemental forces and the Old Gods rather than traditional ancestral spirits. That path lets humans wield elemental devastation.

faq.q: What is Lorgus Jett's connection to Gelihast?
faq.answer: Lorgus Jett and Gelihast both dwell in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps and serve dark powers beneath the sea. Jett often patrols the corridors beyond Gelihast's altar.

angles.text: As a shaman, you wield the elements in harmony or reverence; Jett uses the Twilight's Hammer's corrupted, violent methods.
As a member of the Horde, you can help sever the Twilight's Hammer leadership beneath the Ashenvale shore by striking down Lorgus Jett.
As a human, you may find Jett's service to cosmic terrors far to the west in Kalimdor a chilling sign of the Twilight's Hammer's reach.
